description: This file defines a Retrofit-based network data source for the Android application 'Now in Android'. It includes API interface declarations, a data class for wrapping network responses, and a class implementing data fetching methods with dependency injection and tracing.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetworkApi
classes.description: Internal interface declaring Retrofit API endpoints for fetching topics, news resources, and change lists from the backend.

classes.name: NetworkResponse
classes.description: Generic serializable wrapper class for network responses containing data payload.

classes.name: RetrofitNiaNetwork
classes.description: Singleton class implementing NiaNetworkDataSource, constructed with injected JSON serializer and HTTP call factory, providing methods to fetch network data with tracing.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches list of NetworkTopic objects by their IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Fetches list of NetworkNewsResource objects by their IDs.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of change logs for topics after a specified index.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of change logs for news resources after a specified index.
